title: Descent of finite constant local models
statement: Let T be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and E a sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Suppose an etale cover has on each member U an isomorphism from the restriction of E to a constant sheaf [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] of a finite set S (in the next universe). Then there is a finite etale T-scheme [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category] whose underlying representable presheaf is isomorphic to the underlying presheaf of E.

proof.text: Resize each finite local value to a double ULift of Fin n using Fintype.equivFin. Transport constant sheaves through Etale.overSheafEquiv and apply constantSheaf_sets_representable. Its coproduct codiagonal is finite by IsFinite.sigmaDesc and etale by IsZariskiLocalAtSource.sigmaDesc. An explicit natural isomorphism converts the over-scheme representation into the small-site uliftYoneda representation. This proves finiteConstant_localRepresentative, including empty local values.
Apply finiteLocalModels_descentDatum to these representatives, obtaining an etale surjection, finite etale descent data and the section compatibility equation.

Apply finiteEtaleDescent and choose a preimage P of the datum under its equivalence. Project the preimage isomorphism to an isomorphism in Over U. Transport the supplied pullback square along this isomorphism, and use its datum compatibility to transport the invariance equation for the projection. These are hpr and htr in the Lean proof.

Apply etaleRepresentable_descentGlue with the transported projection and equations. The chosen P is finite etale by its subtype fields; package its underlying scheme, morphism and represented-presheaf isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteLocallyConstant_descent_of_local_models
    (T : Scheme.{u}) (E : Sheaf T.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1)))
    (hlocal : ∃ 𝒰 : Cover.{u} etalePrecoverage T, ∀ i,
      ∃ S : Type (u + 1), Finite S ∧
        Nonempty ((E.over (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) ≅
          (constantSheaf (T.smallEtaleTopology.over
            (𝒰.etalePrecoverageToEtale i)) (Type (u + 1))).obj S)) :
    ∃ (P : Scheme.{u}) (π : P ⟶ T) (_ : IsFinite π) (_ : Etale π),
      Nonempty (E.obj ≅ uliftYoneda.{u + 1}.obj (Etale.mk π))
